name: shorthand-number-field
title: Shorthand number field
description: Type 250k, 1.2M or 3b and it understands: a number field that reads shorthand, shows the full figure under it and reports a plain number.
docs: value and onValueChange speak a plain number, or null when the field was emptied or could not be read; the second argument says whether it is inside min and max, and a number outside them is still reported. It commits on Enter or when the field is left, never while typing. 1,2k and 1.2k both read as 1200.
